StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Detroit:_Become_Human
Fandom (detroit-become-human.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://detroit-become-human.fandom.com/wiki/Detroit:_Become_Human
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Branching narrative game, so chapters split the story rather than modes. 47 of 48 Steam achievements are hidden; the only visible one is "THANK YOU" (Play the first chapter). The Steam API names are plain numbers 1 to 48, listed out of order in the schema (48 and 47 come first), so the numbers were read as story order and the story was cut into thirds at 15 and 31 by exact name; this is a guess, and the unlock rates do not fall steadily, which fits a game where many achievements depend on choices. Numbers 47 ("THESE ARE OUR STORIES", 4.2%) and 48 ("SURVIVORS", 6.9%) were given their own chapter because they come first in the schema and last in the numbering. "BOOKWORM" and "I'LL BE BACK" (1.3% each) sit in the last third by number but may be collection or replay goals. StrategyWiki has "Detroit: Become Human" as a stub at completion stage 0; Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents are linked but none is written, so nothing was used. detroit-become-human.fandom.com answers the API under "Detroit: Become Human" with about 148 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
